Name: Heman
Summary: Heman was named among the wise men with whom Solomon's wisdom was compared. Chronicles also names a Heman son of Zerah and a Heman son of Joel; whether any of these is the same man is not settled, so the profiles are kept separate.
RelatedPeople: King Solomon; Ethan the Ezrahite; Chalcol; Darda
LifeLesson: Wisdom's fame is a gift, not a guarantee.
